name: Killing Animals
overview: Scripture reveals that God granted mankind dominion over animals, as seen in Genesis 1:26, establishing human authority over creation. Initially, man was given plants for food (Genesis 1:29), but after the Flood, God permitted eating animals (Genesis 9:3), indicating a change in dietary provision. The commandment 'Thou shalt not kill' (Exodus 20:13) underscores the sanctity of human life, while Leviticus 24:21 differentiates the consequences for killing animals versus humans, emphasizing the value of life and justice. Additionally, Deuteronomy 25:4 teaches kindness toward working animals, forbidding muzzling an ox while it threshes grain, highlighting responsible stewardship in the use of animals.
